I checked every claim from both investigators against git, the files, paper_materials and all transcripts. I also ran a seed-free replay of the gate geometry: a script in the scratchpad, outside the repo, that recomputes the harness boxes and the gate rule.

**Which commits set the parameters**

Every Work ID identity parameter was set in one of two commits, and none has changed since. `git diff --stat 0fd1e04 81daca4` is empty for phase2/src/identity.py, reid.py, config.py, config.yaml, pipeline.py and phase5_workid/reid_eval.py, and the working tree is clean under phase2/, phase5_workid/ and docs/. HEAD is now 81daca4. It was committed at 2026-11-19 19:00:19 +0800, during this check, and adds only tools/revision and paper_materials/revision_r1.

1. **76d9da5 (Phase 5, 2026-07-25 17:46:19 +0800) set match_threshold 0.62 and margin 0.04.**
   - It was committed in this clone: the reflog has a local `commit` entry.
   - The Claude session behind it was 99419169. Nine memory files cite that session, but no transcript of it survives.
   - The project transcript folder was last modified at 2026-09-21 21:51:07 +0800, so the transcript was removed on or before that moment.
2. **0fd1e04 (Phase 9, 2026-09-02 13:20:16 +0800) set everything else:** probation_frames 3, gate on, gate_slack 0.5, gate_speed 0.03 per frame (0.9 per s), gate_horizon 90 frames (3 s), gate_floor 0.45, OVERRIDE_SIM/OVERRIDE_MARGIN 0.85/0.20, consolidate_margin 0.10 and the hard-coded height-ratio window 0.5-2.0.
   - It was made in a different clone, most likely a different machine. The author e-mail is ivanccj0120@gmail.com, whereas this laptop's ~/.gitconfig uses the noreply address. The only reflog entry is `pull --tags origin main: Fast-forward` at 2026-09-21 21:10:26 +0800.
   - It is the only Phase 9 commit in any local or remote-tracking ref, and there is no stash.
   - The design spec and plan were added in the same commit and never edited.
   - No transcript or scratch output of that work exists here.

**Recorded basis for each value**

- **match_threshold 0.62.** This is the only parameter with a reconstructable tuning run: `python -m phase5_workid.reid_eval --sweep` on the first-round layer, decided on the `similar` scenario, with the CLI defaults (4 workers, 90 frames, gap 12, margin 0.04). That gives seeds 0, 1, 2. The seeds are inferred from the defaults, the twelfths in the README table, and the exact reproduction on 2026-10-04.
  - 0.60, 0.62 and 0.70 tie on all three scenarios, so the stated rule does not single out 0.62.
  - The zero-false-merge boundary between 0.55 and 0.60 comes from seed 0 alone (47 of 312 assignments).
- **Gate on and probation on.** Both are design decisions in the spec, presented with the `--ablation` table: seeds 0-2, confirmed on seeds 0-9. These are the same seeds as every published table.
- **gate_speed.** "Chosen by a sweep" is asserted by one source: spec L93-95. The README defers to it ("the design record says so") and the manuscript copies it.
  - No command, grid, scenario, seed or output exists. The commit message and the plan's step list do not mention a sweep.
  - A post-hoc probe on seeds 0-2 puts a cliff between 0.04 and 0.05.
- **probation 3.** The only stated reason is the constraint "below debounce_frames 5", which allows any value from 1 to 4.
- **No record at all** for margin, gate_slack, gate_horizon, gate_floor, the override, consolidate_margin or the 0.5-2.0 height-ratio window.

**Seeds**

Every recorded Work ID computation before 2026-11-19T10:09:41Z used seeds within 0-9:
- 0-2: the CLI default;
- 0-9: `--seeds 10` and the crosscheck replays;
- 0-3: the unit tests;
- 0-4: one crosscheck descriptor-band analysis.

Seeds of 10 or more first appear in R1: seed 100 at main L6092, then seeds 100-119 at main L6101.

A seed changes only the pixels: the background, the lighting gain and the pixel noise. Boxes, track ids and re-entry timing do not depend on it (reid_eval.py L220-L275; seed 0 and seed 100 give identical boxes). So at the default configuration, held-out seeds test appearance noise on the same geometry the gate was tuned on.

Only the changed configurations move the geometry. The replay shows that only --gap 24 and --workers 6 put a second vacated worker inside the gate. The R1 outputs are consistent with that: identical-PPE enhanced recall is 10% and 8% for those two configurations, against 92-100% for the others.

parameters.how_chosen:
A threshold sweep of the first-round (baseline) layer: probation 1, no gate, commit on first sight.
- Command: `python -m phase5_workid.reid_eval --sweep`.
- Grid: [0.40, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.62, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90] (76d9da5 reid_eval.py L288-289).
- Stated criterion: the highest recall with zero false merges on `similar` (76d9da5 message; README L99-112).

The reproduced grid does not single out 0.62:
- similar: 0.60, 0.62 and 0.70 all give 9/12 = 75%, 0.0% false merge, frag 1.25, 5.0 identities (sweep_3seeds.txt L17-19);
- uniform: 0.50-0.70 all give 1/12, 9.6% (L23-27);
- distinct: 12/12 at every threshold (L6-13).

README L110 ("0.62 is the highest recall that still produces zero false merges") therefore overstates. The manuscript later wrote "within the range (0.60 to 0.70)".

The boundary between 0.55 and 0.60 rests on seed 0 alone: false merges per seed at thresholds of 0.55 and below are [(47,312),(0,312),(0,312)] (compare_out.txt L66-71).

0.62 and the sweep grid were introduced in the same commit (reid_eval.py first appears in 76d9da5). Whether 0.62 was picked before or after the sweep is not recorded.

The threshold was never re-swept for the probation or gate configurations: `--sweep` forces baseline-only (reid_eval.py L716-717).

Not recorded. The spec only lists it (L72-73; L93 '`gate_horizon 90` frames (config: 3 s)'). The `--gate-horizon` flag (reid_eval.py L687-688) has no recorded use.

Derived from the code: it has never bound in any synthetic run.
- In the live gate, dt = the new track's FIRST frame minus the candidate's last sighting. `_match` is called with `at_frame=p.first_frame` (identity.py L280-282, L514, L581).
- So dt is gap+1 for the returning worker and gap+1-4k for the other vacated workers, whatever the probation setting.
- The largest dt in any recorded run is 46 (relocate, gap 45), and the largest in any R1 configuration is 25 (gap 24).
- With --frames 120 at gap 12 the largest dt is still 13: the replay shows max_dt 13 and nothing beyond the horizon.
- The consolidation boundary gaps are bounded by the same re-entry timing.
- In a 90-frame sequence the frame index runs 1-90 (identity.py L209), so dt cannot exceed 89 in any case.

parameters.value:

- identity.py L145 and L164; config.yaml L103; config.py L69 and L326.
- Rule, identity.py L542-549: `if len(plausible) == 1:` ... `if ps >= self.gate_floor and ps >= max(scores):` / `return pu, ps, "position"`.
parameters.how_chosen:
Not recorded. The spec gives the rule (L80-82) and the value (L93) only. The `--gate-floor` flag (reid_eval.py L689-690) has no recorded use.

The unit test builds a 0.55 similarity on purpose, between the floor and the threshold (test_identity.py L228-231, L319-337). It tests the rule, not the value.

Post hoc (crosscheck instrumented replays, seeds 0-9 at gap 12 plus the stress runs on 0-2):
- position-assisted matches occurred 5 times, all in +gate (probation 1), on 10-seed seeds 5, 6 and 9;
- their similarities were 0.457, 0.461, 0.501, 0.544 and 0.607;
- none occurred in the enhanced configuration.

So the floor never decided an enhanced (shipped) match in any recorded synthetic run.

parameters.value:
0.85 / 0.20. These are class constants (identity.py L136-137 `OVERRIDE_SIM = 0.85`, `OVERRIDE_MARGIN = 0.20`), not exposed in config.yaml or the reid_eval CLI (its overrides at L693-697 cover only probation and gate_*).

Applied at identity.py L531-536: `uid_all, best_all = self._decide(uids, scores, threshold, margin)` / `if uid_all in vetoed and best_all >= self.OVERRIDE_SIM and len(scores) >= 2:` / `if best_all - second >= self.OVERRIDE_MARGIN:` / `return uid_all, best_all, "appearance"`.

The candidate must also pass the live threshold and margin, and there must be at least 2 candidates.
parameters.how_chosen:
Not recorded. The spec states the rule and a rationale only (L87-89: 'identical kit can never be decisive and stays vetoed'). As class constants they could not have been swept through the harness CLI, and no code-edit sweep is recorded.

Post hoc (2026-10-04):
